text: This report submits the 2023-2032 Capital Budget of the Toronto Zoo. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2023-2032 Capital Budget on October 3, 2022 and recommended it for approval by the Board.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2023-2032 Capital Budget as shown in Attachment 1 to the report (October 4, 2022) from the Controller, Toronto Zoo.
